purpose: Post-generation and recurring audit for factual reliability, source integrity, misleading claims, IP/media rights, trademark confusion and regulatory exposure.

riskLevels.low: Claims are supported by official sources, uncertainty is preserved, media rights are documented and no misleading commercial implication is created.
riskLevels.medium: Potential ambiguity, source conflict, vendor-only performance claim, incomplete availability data or other issue that can remain public only with explicit attribution and uncertainty.
riskLevels.high: Material unsupported factual claim, false availability/price/partnership/customer/benchmark claim, source fabrication or broken provenance, materially misleading impression, unauthorized media use, trademark/affiliation confusion, copied press-release language beyond reasonable quotation, or another issue likely to create legal/reputational exposure.

requiredChecks: Primary source URL resolves to the supplier, platform owner, regulator or other authoritative first-party source.
Event date, product identity, specifications and announced status match the reviewed official source.
Roadmap, preview, demonstration, sample and production status are not collapsed into current availability.
Pricing, MOQ, lead time, partnerships, customers, shipment status, benchmarks and commercial claims are never invented.
Vendor performance figures are attributed and not presented as independent benchmark results.
Material conflicts between official pages are surfaced as unresolved rather than silently reconciled.
Headline, dek, summary and overall general impression do not imply authorization, endorsement or a commercial relationship with the supplier.
Article language is original reporting and analysis rather than close press-release paraphrase.
Hero and social media rights evidence is present and consistent with the declared asset-rights status.
Source disclosure, editorial independence statement and corrections path remain publicly rendered.

actions.low: Keep publicationStatus=published or leave it unset. Record audit metadata when the audit is performed.
actions.medium: Keep public only if attribution and uncertainty are explicit. Record audit.action=highlight and notify only when editorial correction is advisable.
actions.high: Set publicationStatus=hold immediately, record audit.action=hold with concise findings, and notify the owner with the affected eventId, slug, risk reason and recommended correction.

recheckTriggers: new or modified Industry Signal article
official source becomes unavailable or materially changes
supplier issues a correction, specification revision or availability update
material reader or supplier dispute is received
